items.title: Supporting Innovation: TechnoAi Featured Alongside TII in CPO Strategy Magazine
text: TechnoAi is proud to be part of the broader innovation ecosystem supporting the Technology Innovation Institute (TII) – one of the UAE’s leading research organizations driving advanced technology development across multiple scientific fields.

items.title: TechnoAi and Holybro Announce Strategic Partnership to Advance Autonomous Robotics and Drone Technologies
text: TechnoAi, a UAE-based technology integrator specializing in AI systems, robotics, and advanced drone solutions, has officially announced a strategic partnership with Holybro, a globally recognized developer of open robotics hardware and UAV components.

items.title: TechnoAi and Keenon Robotics Join Forces to Revolutionize Hospitality and Logistics Automation in the Middle East
text: TechnoAi partners with Keenon Robotics to bring advanced service and delivery robots to the Middle East and Africa — transforming hospitality and logistics with intelligent automation and AI-driven efficiency.
